openapoc_modinfo.name: Modern Weapons
openapoc_modinfo.author: Joseph
openapoc_modinfo.description: Modern ballistic weapon platforms with distinct handling profiles. Adds the Osiron Arms 109 assault rifle (hard-hitting, rugged, cheap) and the Marsec-15A carbine (accurate, fast-handling, premium), each with its own magazine, market availability and character-sheet art.
